The Okafor Family | Lagos, Nigeria
September 2026 Update

Dear partners,

What a joy-filled month! The community center renovation finished ahead of schedule, and we held our grand reopening with over 200 neighbors attending. The new computer lab is already booked solid for after-school tutoring.

Our daughter Amara graduated top of her class and starts university in January -- we are so proud of her.

We've also been encouraged by the steady growth of our Tuesday Bible study, now meeting in two groups because the first outgrew the living room.

Thank you for your faithful partnership. We don't have any specific needs to share this month, just gratitude.

With love,
David and Chioma Okafor
